@the.arbory is definitely one of the best wedding venues in Chicago!! 

If you’re looking for a warm, loft-style space with some life in it - this is the venue for you. They natural light with the skylights, the warm, string lights in the evening, the ability to have your ceremony and reception in one space, and the plants scattered throughout the venue and on the walls are definitely some of our favorite parts. 

You absolutely need to check out The Arbory if you are looking for a wedding venue - we highly recommend it!!!

A travel love story coming together for one memorable day. Dylan and Bryce have been all over the world, whether for a visit, or sometimes even setting down roots from time to time.

Flowers and plants were chosen to represent locations along their voyages through which guests were submersed into their lives...past, present and future.

It was a special touch to even grow some of the zinnia varieties myself, and over 75% of the florals were locally sourced. This wedding truly was the artsy paradise picture we painted nearly a year prior. Thank you Dylan and Bryce for your trust!

Fitting that the date of C&J’s wedding was 10/10, because this wedding was a 10 out of 10!!!

Three of my favorite parts of the day: 

The sky was filled with thick clouds all morning and afternoon, and at the start of their ceremony, the clouds parted to reveal a gorgeous sunset. I will not forget their faces we walked outside on the iconic @waldenchicago rooftop after the ceremony for photos, they had grins as big as the skyline behind them. The golden hour they’d been hoping for came through just in time. It was a perfect setting to soak up the just married feeling for a quiet moment before rejoining the party. 

The parents!!!! They were beyond giddy, warm, supportive, grateful & fun every minute of the day. Hence the full slide dedicated to them being cute af with each other and the newlyweds. My heart melted when they asked for a photo of just the four of them during family photos. 

The photo booth fatheads of their pug 🥹 always here for when the dogs are at the party in spirit. 

Shoutout to the amazing team who kept this day relaxed & constantly ahead of schedule —
